the best activation function is RReLU, which is a randomized Leaky ReLU.
, in convolutional network, using a randomized leaky rectification is a good choice for both large scale dataset and small scale dataset, especially for small scale dataset.
, in the context of convolutional network, ReLU is a special case of Leaky ReLU, and RReLU is a better choice than ReLU and Leaky ReLU in most cases.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the performance of ReLU and its variant are not as good as the common belief.
the performance of different rectified activation functions are not significantly different, but the randomized ones are more robust.
the performance of different activation function is highly data dependent.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, in order to improve the accuracy of deep convolutional neural network, we should consider using randomized leaky rectifier units.
the performance gain of rectified activation units are more related to their nonlinearity rather than sparsity.
